preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some INCOME tokens to sell

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setExtraFeeOnSell() with a value greater than 25 (e.g., 50) to set an excessive sell fee. Then sell tokens through the DEX pair to trigger the high fee mechanism, which will transfer a larger portion of the sale proceeds to the contract (and subsequently to marketing/dividends). The owner can then withdraw funds via SafeToken functions or benefit from the fee redistribution.
